author: Hermann Hesse
introFa: کتاب «Siddhartha» نوشته Hermann Hesse یکی از منابع ارزشمند و معتبر برای یادگیری زبان انگلیسی در سطح B2 است. این اثر با ساختاری منسجم و غنی، شما را در تسلط بر واژگان و درک مطلب یاری می‌کند.
readingTipsFa: پیش از مطالعه هر بخش از کتاب «Siddhartha»، نگاهی سریع به تیترها و ساختار آن بیندازید.
واژگان و اصطلاحات جدید را در زمینه و بافت جمله یادداشت کنید تا در حافظه بلندمدت تثبیت شوند.
پس از پایان هر فصل، نکات کلیدی و آموخته‌های خود را مرور کرده و به زبان خود خلاصه کنید.

content: s Preface The World is witness to the evolution of art from the Stone Age to the present times. Paintings have always made life delightful. With pure art at its core, paintings have moved lives to the peace of mind. We have a firm belief in a good artwork, as it inspires a good living. Good paintings stimulate good ideas. Good ideas give you passion. Passion empowers you. Good paintings assemble a world of positive vibes within your home that lets you enjoy life to the fullest. What we want and what we need keeps changing. With this perpetual change, the idea of a better home keeps changing too. And unfailingly, with ideas around, we nurture them only to mould them into reality. Because we know, it’s not just the idea, but it’s how you represent it, that shapes your mind. Discover the world within you. Portfolio 2021 Portfolio 2020 Portfolio 2019 Portfolio 2018 02

Artist`s Statement “Without the ability to actualize an idea or concept art would not exist. I work hard to develop paintings that speak both to me as well as to others about the beauty that exists in this world. Part of my process before i begin painting is to study as much as possible about the specific subject which i am about to recreate on canvas. I do not merely want to capture the image with my brushes; rather, with careful, colourful strokes I want to give that subject life once more. My work is the constant search for the best way to interpret the ideas that I have about myself and the world I live in. I do not limit myself to one medium, style or concept. Inspiration and ideas change, knowledge changes. Each art piece I create is simultaneously an extension from the past where I have come from and what I have learned, as well as the preview of the future where i am going. With every finished stroke I try to breathe life into the subject so that its beauty is perfectly displayed on my canvas. The challenge is not to caricature the subject and instead capture it in all its former glory. If a viewer stops for just a moment to view and reflect on piece that I have created, then I have succeeded in my work.” - Siddhartha Dharane “Balancing career and hobby is not everybody`s cup of tea. Sometimes in the race of career, hobby is left aside. But few people easily do both. One of them is renowned artist and engineer Siddhartha Ravindra Dharane who took his hobby to new heights.” - Dainik Bhaskar “Formal education is must to do anything, is the thinking of youngsters; but if art is within you then success doest stay too far. This can be experienced from the journey of Tryambakeshwar`s young artist Siddhartha Ravindra Dharane” - Dainik Pudhari “City based youngster Siddhartha Ravindra Dharane marks his presence in the field of art by his astonishing skills” -Lokmat Times “Hometown Tryambakeshwar, name Siddhartha Ravindra Dharane. A computer engineer. But due to his hobby, he is a renowned artist in the world of art” -Dainik Lokmat 03

Siddhartha Ravindra Dharane, an engineer by profession and an artist by passion. Considered radical in his work, Siddhartha continues to garner reverence for his technical mastery, visionary creativity and profound empathy. He picked up taste in art in his early childhood. Early in his career Siddhartha participated in many painting competitions. However, his first National level championship changed his life and he started developing his skills. Siddhartha Dharane is renowned for endlessly reinventing himself, switching between styles so radically that his work seems to be the product of multiple artists rather than just one. His narrative paintings, executed in a modified realistic style, can be caustic and playful as well as serious and sombre. His themes, sometimes treated in series, include topics as diverse as nature, wildlife, historical architectures, monuments and motifs of Indian urban and rural life. He enjoys depicting the lively and free spirit of mythology in many of his works. Siddhartha Dharane`s artwork is not a painting to pass unnoticed. It reflects an idea that strikes an emotion and seizes the senses. It is lush and chic, endowed with mesmerizing concepts. It bears homage to time-honoured classics of fine arts. About us “It doesn’t matter who I am, but what I do that defines me.” 04

05 Siddhartha Dharane`s is an art gallery with a design philosophy that follows a “LAWLESS” method for art. Unconventional as it may sound, it has been our signature that helps us to tailor make paintings and reinvent constantly in the name of bespoke art. Our brief 14 year history is landmarked with recognition and applauds, reinforcing our “Methods with Madness”. We believe that paintings are an extension of your aesthetic and hence need to be as exclusive. We offer to customise your space as per your requirement. Concept, theme, dimensions, colour schemes, you wish we paint. Paintings bespoke your own imagination! Siddhartha Dharane creates custom artworks that are tailor made to each individual client. Essentially incorporating the essence of modern homemaker, our paintings are a premium expansion of individuality coalesced to suit the global sensibilities. Working with innovative concepts, the paintings are painted to represent perfection. Each Siddhartha Dharane painting is a highly personalized painting with that encapsulates all different aspects of a quality world class artwork. “Distinctively Inspiring, Impressively Different” “Adorn your space with a new aura. ”

“Dreams created with colors...” A beautiful dream if it were to come true, to remain forever, we would like to think of it to be made in colours, something that comes naturally to human beings, for colours are timeless, unique, beautiful and special. With a painting painted with finest detail possible, Siddhartha`s paintings are not just paintings, they are stories and poems written by the strokes and nurtured by colours. In them, he rediscovered his dreams and achieved the following milestones on this victory road:  Winner of International Fashion Week 2019  Three National Level Painting Championships  Eight State Level Painting Championships  Twelve District Level Championships  Tryambakeshwar Bhushan Puraskar by municipal council.  Prestigious Ganga-Godavari Puraskar twice  Eleven S.Y.M.B.S. I think life happens in a blurry motion and I want to explore that idea in this project. —- newly finished project for Naisha International.

40 D E C E M B E R 2 0 2 1 Panipat, INDIA Final painting of 2021. “A Letter to your loved ones” acrylic painting on canvas. Most of the time I like to live a life fully in the present. But I think it’s so important to take a day and reflect. Today is that day for me. Today I look back on the year and think about the ups and the downs and more importantly, what I’ve learned from it all. I like to write it all down in a letter to my parents because they are always with you for your entire lifetime. A letter of reflection. But after this I think it’s important to return back to the present and enjoy every moment of life. It’s all happening now. What would your letter say? True love doesn't happen by accident… It's deliberate, It’s intentional, It’s purposeful, And in the end... It’s worth it.

INTERNATIONAL INTERACTIONS USA Lockdown was both – a difficult time as well as an opportunistic phase. From inception, we seeks to derive significant competitive advantage from the use of resources and this time we did the same. This year we had consultancy projects for our clients based in United States including some space designs, product designs, experience design and visual arts. AUSTRIA It’s not enough to know how to mix the right paint or use the right brushes. Paintings don’t magically turn into food or money to pay the bills. In addition to painting, I believe we must take the time to learn how to make a living with our art so that we can have the freedom to continue to share our art with the world. This was well demonstrated in the Art Workshop organized by ARTMate. SPAIN We seek the fire of the spark that is already within us. Celebrate the best in opportunities we are thankful and feeling blessed to be associated of globally renowned architectural firm – Pioz Architects. Taking the opportunity to be their international representative for India we had a fantastic experience this year and the best part was learning from Dr. Javier Pioz himself. SWITZERLAND The mind is not a vessel to be filled but a fire to be kindled. This year gave us a fantastic opening in Europe via Switzerland. Multiple paintings were exported to Switzerland in 2021 and we got this opportunity to learn European taste and culture through this interaction. Raw yet enthralling, our distinctive approach created stirs. INDIA Home is where our story begins…Home is not a place…it’s a feeling. And that’s why our homeland – India – is our ultimate work destination. This year we had projects all over the country in vivid criteria including visual arts, space designs, creative solutions, product designs, corporate branding designs and commercial designs.
